name: Mercy USA for Aid and Development
mission: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is dedicated to alleviating human suffering and supporting individuals and their communities in their efforts to become more self-sufficient. Our philosophy is "Helping People Help Themselves".  Incorporated in the State of Michigan in 1988, Mercy-USA's projects focus on improving health, nutrition and access to safe water, as well as promoting economic and educational growth and providing disaster relief around the world.

Combined with a lean fundraising model spending <cite id="1">$0.02 per $1 raised</cite>, the charity ensures maximum donor funds reach operational programs. rich_narrative.summary: Mercy-USA for Aid and Development is an established humanitarian organization that delivers vital health, nutrition, and emergency relief services to vulnerable populations across Somalia, Syria, Gaza, and Yemen. In FY2024, the organization generated <cite id="3">$34,922,507 in total revenue</cite> to support its global crisis operations. The organization operates with exceptional cost efficiency, directing a <cite id="1">96.0% program expense ratio</cite> toward direct relief efforts, while maintaining a cash-adjusted program ratio score of <cite id="1">93%</cite>. The organization holds a <cite id="1">92.3/100 rating from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting solid accountability and organizational culture. Mercy-USA focuses heavily on healthcare and nutrition for children and mothers, while also maintaining robust clean water initiatives. In Somalia, the organization achieved an <cite id="4">80% tuberculosis cure rate</cite> and provided <cite id="4">safe water access to 750,000 people</cite>. Despite operational successes, revenue experienced a recent contraction from $54,067,823 in FY2023 to $34,922,507 in FY2024. However, its low fundraising costs of <cite id="1">$0.02 per $1 raised</cite> ensure that donor contributions directly fund critical field programs.
